payload.title: DEC-RUN-REC-DURABILITY: decide Runtime checkpoint vs Recordings history ownership
currentProgress: PSS plan Runtime sequence step 7 requires an explicit Runtime-checkpoint versus Recordings-history ownership decision before Checkpoint/Recovery implementation.
IMP-RUN-04 (checkpoint_recovery) has been held indefinitely without an owning decision packet; customer ask requires progress rather than permanent hold.
CTR-RUN and CTR-REC are Factory-terminal; IMP-RUN-01..03 and IMP-REC-* foundations exist; Recordings durable log/cursor/retention is still a later Recordings sequence step.
Plan keeps Checkpoint Service non-top-level and treats Checkpoint/Recovery as a Runtime private subservice after the durability decision.
payload.requestedOutcome: Publish an explicit, checked-in durability decision that unblocks IMP-RUN-04 without waiting for a future Recordings durable-log deployment split. Required decision content: (1) Runtime owns opaque strategy checkpoint capture/load/compatibility/restore inside internal/services/checkpoint_recovery; checkpoints are versioned opaque blobs plus Runtime-owned codec selection, never Petri/JS internals on the peer surface. (2) Recordings remains the durable history/artifact authority for canonical events, replay artifacts, and any future durable checkpoint byte storage; Runtime must not become a second event ledger. (3) IMP-RUN-04 may proceed now against a Runtime-owned opaque CheckpointStore port with a process-local/default adapter sufficient for compatible restore and corrupt-checkpoint proofs; a Recordings-backed durable store adapter is an explicit follow-on after Recordings durable log/cursor/retention exists and is not a gate for starting IMP-RUN-04. (4) Sessions durable_execution continues to coordinate resume identity through Recordings + Runtime root contracts rather than importing checkpoint internals. Write the decision into docs/temp/projects/packaged-service-structure/ (decision note + checklist/plan cross-links) and update planner meta hold text so IMP-RUN-04 becomes dependency-ready after this packet is Factory-complete. Do not implement checkpoint_recovery code in this packet. Do not invent a top-level Checkpoint service. Do not change Runtime/Recordings public package layout beyond docs/checklist/meta. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green (docs/checklist verification jobs as applicable), every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
changedPathLease: docs/temp/meta.md hold text for IMP-RUN-04 only if the PR includes planner-state guidance the repo tracks
exclude creating a top-level Checkpoint service
acceptanceCriteria: A checked-in decision artifact states Runtime owns opaque checkpoint_recovery and Recordings owns durable history/artifact authority
Decision explicitly authorizes IMP-RUN-04 to start with a Runtime opaque CheckpointStore port + process-local/default adapter
Decision explicitly defers Recordings-backed durable checkpoint storage to a follow-on after Recordings durable log work
Checklist/plan/meta no longer describe IMP-RUN-04 as blocked solely by a missing decision owner
No checkpoint_recovery implementation ships in this packet

Implementing checkpoint_recovery or Recordings durable log inside the decision packet
Making Runtime a second canonical event ledger
Requiring full Recordings durable-log completion before any IMP-RUN-04 admission
